url.public: ?public=1 when the toggle is on, omitted otherwise
url.q: ?q=<text> over client and firm, omitted when empty
url.filing: ?filing=<uuid> opens the filing modal; survives refresh
url.history: filter changes use router.replace; opening a modal pushes one history entry so Back closes it

filter_bar.position: sticky under the shared chrome, full-bleed hairlines top and bottom
row_1: period segmented (FY 2024, FY 2025, 2026 YTD, Quarter, 90 days; Quarter opens a small quarter picker)
min-amount slider over the discrete stops with the current stop labelled in mono
filter_bar.row_2: issue chips: All + top 12 by filing count with live mono counts, then an 'All 79 issues…' chip opening a searchable sheet; selected chip emerald
filter_bar.phone: row of scrolling issue chips plus a Filters chip (count of non-default filters) opening a bottom sheet: period, entity, min, toggle, search, Reset, 'Show N filings'
filter_bar.live_counts: issue chip counts respect period, entity, min and public filters

ratio: window toggle only (1y/2y); page filters do not apply, the ratio endpoint is per-ticker aggregate
members: period (LD-203 semiannual periods map from the page period), type chips, min

pulse.yoy: vs same period last year, emerald up, --echo-chart-red down, sign and arrow always
pulse.note: spend tile carries the registrations note

leaderboard.row: rank, name, ticker chip when mapped, bar vs rank 1, spend mono, share of period total
leaderboard.row_click: opens the client drawer: sparkline of filings over time, issues cited, firms hired, latest filings each linking to the filing modal
leaderboard.coverage: amber chip when ingest-status says the period is below 100%

issues.row_click: sets ?issue= and the chip row; aria-pressed on the active row

pressure.cell_hover: tooltip: issue x body, filing count, top three clients for the cell
pressure.scroll: horizontal scroll inside the card under 1100px
pressure.a11y: visually hidden table fallback with the same counts

rhythm.ghost: unfiled future quarters draw dashed ghost bars labelled 'Not yet filed'
rhythm.partial: the in-progress quarter carries the received percent from ingest-status

door.expand: firm row expands to covered positions as filed; one open at a time; aria-expanded

lens.tile_click: opens the company modal: price chart with quarterly lobbying spend overlaid as bars, largest filings, firms hired; emerald only
lens.badges: verified: solid patch-check in emerald; exact-name: dashed 'Name match' chip with the tooltip

members.tabs: Top honorees | Top committees | Largest items
members.type_chips: FECA, Honorary, Meeting, Inaugural, Library with mono counts; chips filter the card

table.row: View opens the filing modal; issues render as max 3 chips plus +N
table.csv: Export CSV signed-in; signed-out shows the link disabled with a sign-in tooltip

states.loading: shimmer skeleton in each card's own shape; reserved heights so nothing jumps
states.empty: one sentence naming the active filters plus a way out; Reset chip on Pulse and Table
states.partial: amber chip '{quarter} is still being filed, {pct}% received' on Pulse, Leaderboard, Issues, Pressure; rhythm flags the bar
states.error: standard line + Retry refetching only that card

keyboard.focus: 2px emerald ring, offset 2, on every chip, segment, slider, toggle, row, cell group, tab and link
keyboard.segments_chips: radiogroup/radio; tabs are tablist/tab with arrow keys
keyboard.slider: role slider, arrow keys move between stops, aria-valuetext is the stop label
keyboard.modals: focus trap, Escape closes, focus returns to the opener; drawer likewise
keyboard.rows: clickable rows are buttons; expanders separate buttons with aria-expanded

motion.reduced_motion: no shimmer, no ticks, instant states
